tells.1: Stock closer (“spot areas that need a closer look”) and the last step mostly repeats its heading.
tells.2: “Some valuable insight” is empty filler, and the final step adds nothing new.
tells.3: “Build the images into crop health maps” is an unnatural collocation, and “the maps reach you” is oddly personified.
tells.4: Same “maps reach you” personification, plus a limp “and they help you” tack-on.
tells.5: “In your inbox” clashes with “in hand,” and “patches deserve” is slightly precious.
tells.6: “We count the 48 hours from the flight” over-explains a simple promise in a robotic way.

reason: Version 5 is the only one with a distinct copywriter’s voice and a benefit-led opener worth publishing. The rest mostly paraphrase one tidy three-step template, and version 6’s clock explanation is the least human.
